summary.brief: A time‑lapse shows an artist painting a teal‑haired portrait, finishes with a close‑up of the eyes, pans out to reveal the studio, and ends with short social‑media graphics.
summary.detailed: The video opens with a title card that reads “Lena Danya Art” in white cursive over a blurry, colorful background. A palette of tubes and brushes is shown, then the camera moves to an easel holding a white canvas in front of a white wall, a black‑framed painting, and a door. The artist’s right hand appears, holding a brush and applying brown paint to sketch the outline of a woman’s face. She builds the portrait from the bottom upward, layering light blue, darker blues, pinks and other hues to create teal‑colored hair, blue eyes, pink lips, and a floral background. Throughout the process she switches between small and slightly larger brushes to add finer details, especially around the eyes. Around the 146‑second mark the view tightens on the brushstrokes that outline the eyes, then the camera pulls back to reveal the completed portrait on the easel within a dimly lit studio filled with art supplies, a white wall and a door. The final seconds show a brief clip of the artist making a smoothie, images of pictures and a balcony scene, followed by blue‑and‑white social‑media graphics and a fade to black.

action.detailed: Apply brushstrokes to the canvas, beginning with a brown outline of the face and then layering light blue, darker blues, pinks and other colors to create the hair, skin, and floral background, finishing with fine detail on the eyes.

summary.brief: A time‑lapse shows a girl painting a teal‑haired woman's portrait, beginning with a brown outline and building up blues, pinks and floral details.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with a white‑cursive title card that reads “Lena Danya Art” against a blurred, multicoloured background. It then cuts to close‑up shots of a palette, tubes of paint and brushes as the artist mixes pigments. The view shifts to an overhead shot of a blank white canvas on an easel placed in front of a white wall, with a hanging painting on the left and a white door on the right. A girl, seen from behind, starts by applying a thin brown line to sketch the face of a woman with teal (turquoise) hair.
